errors.evidence: The y-axis label is "килограми от хектар" (kilograms per hectare), not "хиляди хектари" (thousands of hectares).
The intervals on the y-axis are 500 units, as shown by the labels (e.g., 4000 - 3500 = 500), not 100.
The blue line is solid, not dotted ('пунктирана').

errors.text_span: с маркери във формата на кръг
errors.evidence: The blue line does not have any visible markers.
The peak of the blue line in 2015 is at approximately 6700, which is visibly above the 6500 gridline, not at 6600.

errors.text_span: намалява до минимална стойност от 4900 в координатите (2016, 4900)
errors.evidence: The value of the blue line in 2016 is approximately 5800, not 4900. Furthermore, this is not the minimum value; the minimum is in 2014 at approximately 4100.
The value of the blue line in 2018 is approximately 6100, not 6300.

errors.text_span: В периода от 2021 до 2022 година линията се стабилизира на ниво 5700.
errors.evidence: The blue line does not stabilize. It rises to a peak of approximately 6250 in 2021 and then drops to approximately 5600 in 2022.

errors.text_span: с маркери във формата на триъгълник
errors.evidence: The orange line does not have any visible markers.
The starting value of the orange line in 2014 is approximately 4400, not 4800.
The peak of the orange line in 2015 is approximately 7250, well above the 7000 gridline, not 6900.
The value of the orange line in 2016 is exactly on the 5000 gridline, not 5500.
The value of the orange line in 2017 is approximately 6750, not 6200.
The value of the orange line in 2019 is approximately 6400, not 5700. Also, the trend is incorrect; the line drops in 2018 and then rises in 2019.

errors.text_span: За периода 2020 — 2022 линията показва тенденция на покачване
errors.evidence: The trend for the orange line from 2020 to 2022 is not just upward; it rises from 2020 to 2021 and then falls in 2022.
The value of the orange line in 2022 is approximately 6150, not 6500.
